model.description: Input LS-DYNA .k file containing the TET4 part to remesh

output.description: Output LS-DYNA .k file with remeshed part (other parts preserved)

pid.description: Part ID of the TET4 element part to remesh

lc_target.description: Target average element size for remesh

lc_min.description: Minimum element size (-1 = auto from edge_min*0.8 or min_dt-based)

min_dt.description: LS-DYNA explicit time step lower bound (for auto lc_min calculation)

min_layers_thin.description: Minimum element layers through thin dimension for thin-solid handling

adaptive.description: Enable MathEval distance-field size adaptation around bbox corners

decay_factor.description: Corner refinement decay distance = lc_min * decay_factor

boundary_nodes.description: Boundary node handling: free (new IDs) | fixed (match original) | snap (merge to neighbors)

snap_tolerance.description: Search radius for snap mode boundary node merging

algorithm.description: Gmsh 3D mesh algorithm (hxt=parallel hybrid, frontal3d=advancing front, del3d=Delaunay)

optimize_netgen.description: Enable Gmsh built-in Netgen optimization after Mesh 3

optimize_passes.description: Number of additional OptimizeMesh Netgen passes after Mesh 3 (skipped for thin geometry)

quality_check.description: Report scaled-Jacobian quality statistics after remesh

warn_min_jac.description: Warn if elements have scaled Jacobian below this threshold

refine_surface.description: STL surface refinement levels (-1=auto, 0=off, 1-3=conforming feature-edge bisection)

smooth_surface.description: Laplacian smoothing steps on STL feature-edge vertices (0=off)

polish_jac.description: Polish target: re-mesh patches with scaled Jacobian below this

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
